messages:
alex: Heads-up: Infra has a partner request to export ~90 days of session + auth logs for vuln triage. They want full session IDs and request/response context.

maria: Oof. Our default is 7d for raw exports. 90d is outside policy. Do we have a formal export lease flow documented?

sam: Partner insists they need end-to-end session traces to reconstruct attack chain. We can filter event classes, but session_id and some identifiers are non-negotiable for them. That will require KMS unwrap and scoped Decrypt permissions.

alex: Proposal: require a short-lived export lease ticket + approvals (SecOps, Incident Responder, Legal for partner contracts), DLP scan success, ephemeral encrypted staging (s3://exports-ephemeral/<ticket>), and automated SIEM audit markers. Redact/hash PII before export.

maria: +1 to ephemeral staging + DLP gating. Also require that KMS grants are explicit and timeboxed; no persistent Decrypt perms for Ops. Include a signed attestation from the partner on retention and deletion.

sam: KMS grant sketch: role=export-service, action=kms:Decrypt, condition timeboxed. Example IAM condition: `DateLessThan: 2026-02-01T00:00:00Z`. Keep principle scoped to the export lambda or short-lived worker.

oncall-jane: I can create the timeboxed CMK grant once ticket and justification are in. Policy: export to `s3://exports-ephemeral/<ticket>/` only. No direct reads from primary buckets. Prefer lifecycle 72h and auto-delete.

security-bot: Note: Prior export to external vendor X (2025-11-03) lacked redaction and caused an incident (INC-43). Recommend adding stricter gating and audit markers.

maria: Exactly. We should codify who can approve exports that contain session-level identifiers: SecOps lead, Infra lead, and Legal. Add a pre-approval checklist: contract clause, DPIA/DLP results, POA&M for partner handling.

alex: I'll draft a runbook + small terraform module to formalize. Config fields to include: `kms_grant_duration`, `export_filters`, `dlp_threshold`, `ephemeral_ttl`, `approver_matrix`. I'll open a PR for review.

sam: SIEM changes: tag export lifecycle events with `meta.export_ticket`, `meta.approver`, and `meta.export_stage` (created, staged, downloaded, deleted). Create an ingest rule `external_export` so we can easily query export activity. Example: `meta.export_ticket: TICKET-2026-110`, `meta.approver: maria`, `meta.export_stage: staged`.

maria: Legal requires DLP artifacts attached to ticket. Deny export if PII above threshold. Also require confirmation from Tech Solutions that exported dataset cannot be re-ingested into our primary analytics.

alex: Quick runbook excerpt to include in PR:

```
- Ticket template fields: requestor, ticket_id, justification, data_window, event_classes, filters, partner_name, legal_signoff, dlp_report_link, approvers
- KMS: grant CMK decrypt to `role/export-service` timeboxed to `kms_grant_duration`
- Storage: write to `s3://exports-ephemeral/<ticket>/`; lifecycle_days = `ephemeral_ttl`
- Redaction: apply configured redact_fields and hash identifiers as required
- DLP: run automated scan; attach results to ticket; abort on threshold exceed
- SIEM: emit `external_export` events with meta.* tags for every stage
```

oncall-jane: Creating ticket now: TICKET-2026-110. I will provision a CMK grant template and ephemeral bucket template. ETA EOD tomorrow for templates and IAM snippets.

alex: Action items: 1) I open PR with runbook + tf module, 2) @oncall-jane creates CMK grant + bucket template and attaches ticket, 3) SecOps (maria) to sign off on DLP threshold and approval matrix, 4) Sam to update SIEM ingest rule after PR.

maria: Please make approval matrix explicit in PR (who can approve what - export sizes, data classes). Add rollback: revoke CMK grant + run S3 delete if partner fails audit.

alex: Will include. Pinging when PR is up. :thumbsup:
